name: Backlink Outreach JS
headline: Automated Backlink Outreach Agent for SEO
short_description: The Backlink Building Agent automates the outreach process by identifying potential websites, collecting contact information, and generating personalized messages across various platforms like email and social media. This tool enhances SEO efforts through efficient backlink acquisition.
author: danpoletaev

sections.overview:
The Backlink Building Agent automates link-building efforts by identifying backlink opportunities through keyword-based SERP analysis. It filters relevant websites, extracts contact details, and generates personalized outreach sequences with three-message campaigns for email, LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook. The agent analyzes target page content via markdown to create contextually relevant messages with specific anchor text recommendations. Output integrates directly with marketing automation platforms like Make, n8n, Hubspot, Salesforce, and Attio. This tool helps SEO teams scale outreach by automating prospect identification, contact discovery, and message personalization based on your business description and target keywords.
Automating outreach for backlink acquisition
Personalizing messages for potential link partners
Finding relevant websites for SEO improvement
Managing outreach campaigns across multiple platforms
sections.usage:
```
I need to build backlinks for my [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Find 20 high-quality websites with a domain authority of 30+ that could link to my [DATA] content. Then, draft personalized outreach emails for each, highlighting how a backlink would benefit both parties.
```
